description: Source code implementing PHY management interface for Xilinx GEM Ethernet driver, supporting multiple PHY models including Marvell and Texas Instruments, with functions for MDIO read/write, PHY reset, configuration, status polling, and detection.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads PHY data via MDIO interface, with timeout and logging.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes PHY data via MDIO interface, with timeout and logging.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_marvell_alaska_cfg
methods.description: Configures Marvell Alaska PHY series, including auto-negotiation and MDIX settings.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_marvell_alaska_poll_sc
methods.description: Polls PHY status change events for Marvell Alaska PHY.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_marvell_alaska_poll_lsts
methods.description: Polls link status for Marvell Alaska PHY.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_marvell_alaska_poll_lspd
methods.description: Polls link speed for Marvell Alaska PHY.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_ti_dp83822_cfg
methods.description: Configures TI TLK105 / DP83822 PHY, including auto-negotiation and LED settings.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_ti_dp83822_poll_sc
methods.description: Polls PHY status change events for TI PHYs.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_ti_dp83822_poll_lsts
methods.description: Polls link status for TI PHYs.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_ti_dp83822_poll_lspd
methods.description: Polls link speed for TI PHYs.

methods.name: phy_xlnx_gem_detect
methods.description: Detects supported PHY device on MDIO bus and initializes PHY access API.
